question: Which of the following will be formed when dilute hydrochloric acid is added to a beaker having copper oxide?

options.text: A solution with blue-green colour is formed due to the formation of copper (III) chloride.
A solution with green colour is formed due to the formation of copper (II) chloride.
A colourless solution is formed due to the formation of copper (II) chloride.
A solution with blue-green colour is formed due to the formation of copper (II) chloride.

solution:
The correct answer is __**A solution with blue-green colour is formed due to the formation of copper (II) chloride.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• When dilute hydrochloric acid (HCl) is added to copper oxide (CuO), a chemical reaction takes place.
 
• The reaction forms copper (II) chloride (CuCl₂) and water (H₂O).
 
• Copper (II) chloride is a blue-green colored compound.
 
• The balanced chemical equation for the reaction is: CuO + 2HCl → CuCl₂ + H₂O.
 
• The blue-green color of the solution is due to the presence of copper (II) ions in the aqueous solution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Copper (II) Chloride**

 
 
• Copper (II) chloride is often used in textile dyeing and printing.
 
• It can also act as a catalyst in organic reactions.
 
 
 
• **Hydrochloric Acid (HCl)**
 
 
• Hydrochloric acid is a strong acid commonly used in laboratories and industry.
 
• It is also found in the stomach, where it aids in digestion.
 
 
 
• **Copper Oxide (CuO)**
 
 
• Copper oxide is a black solid that is used in pigments and ceramics.
 
• It is also used in the production of copper compounds and as a catalyst in chemical reactions.
